# `billing_account_permissions` — version 1.2

Source: `presets/billing-account-permissions.satz`

## Purpose

Billing-account IAM, split by audience.

Everyone in the domain may USE and VIEW the billing account (link projects,
read costs); the full administration — and every other billing-account role —
goes to ONE group, named by a param so no customer forks the pack for it. The
IaC service account keeps `billing.admin`: it manages this account's budgets
and project links on every apply.

## Use it

```
params {
  // the pack's own defaults — copy only the lines you change
  billing_admins_group = "gcp-billing-admins@{customer_domain}"
}

use "presets/billing-account-permissions.satz"
```

**Needs from outside the pack:**

- `billing_account_infra` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `customer_domain` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `infra_project_name` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `svc_iac_account` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.

## Params

| param | default |
|---|---|
| `billing_admins_group` | `"gcp-billing-admins@{customer_domain}"` |

## Questions

What to ask before this pack is configured, and what changing the answer costs.

| asks about | prompt | reversal | blast | recommends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `billing_admins_group` | The group that administers the billing account (a full address) | edit | high | — |

**billing_admins_group** — This group gets billing.admin and billing.costsManager on the account: it can move projects between billing accounts and see every cost. The default is the S1 model's billing-admins group; another model names its own.

## Notes

<!-- notes:start — hand-written, kept across `satz doc-packs` -->

The IaC service account keeps `billing.admin` here because it links projects and manages budgets on every apply — narrowing it breaks `bootstrap` and any project creation.

A reseller billing account lives in another organisation: the grant is applied by whoever administers that account, not by this estate's service account.

<!-- notes:end -->
